### Sometimes Pain Is a Good Thing
Author: Kenisha Bethea
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-august-30-2018.html
Passage: Romans 2:4
Points:
- Physical pain serves a protective role by warning people to stop and seek help.
- In a similar manner, emotional and spiritual pain alerts us when we stray into destructive habits.
- God's patience and forbearance are given not to excuse sin, but to draw our hearts to repentance.
- Rather than numbing inward distress, facing it honestly allows God's kindness to bring true healing.

### "Let Me Help You with That Speck"
Author: Laura MacCorkle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/let-me-help-you-with-that-speck-crosswalk-the-devotional-aug-11-2010-11635298.html
Passage: Romans 2:1
Points:
- Criticizing others over external matters often masks blindness to personal spiritual flaws.
- Passing judgment on another person renders us inexcusable because we commit the same faults.
- Only God can accurately judge the hidden intentions and conditions of human hearts.
- Seeing our own hypocrisy should turn our focus toward repentance and God's mercy.

### Small Adjustments Can Make a Big Difference
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-may-4-2016.html
Passage: Romans 2:4
Points:
- Daily spiritual adjustments help keep a believer's heart aligned with God's purpose.
- Humility is essential because God is the true judge of every person's life.
- Prayer allows the Holy Spirit to convict us of unkind attitudes, harsh words, and hidden rebellion.
- Experiencing the Lord's continuous mercy and kindness gently leads us to genuine repentance.

### Without Excuse
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/without-excuse
Passage: Romans 2:1-2
Points:
- Condemning the sins of others proves we understand that evil deserves judgment.
- Judging others leaves a person without excuse when they practice the same wrongs.
- Religious heritage or external morality offers no special exemption before God's impartial justice.
- Facing our own moral failure under God's standard must drive us to seek grace in the gospel.
